sourceDocuments.title: Historiography of the Benin Expedition of 1897
sourceDocuments.text: The British punitive military expedition of 1897 resulted in the burning of Benin City, the exile of Oba Ovonramwen to Calabar, and the widespread looting of royal ivory and bronze artworks.

studentDocument.title: Diplomatic Relations of the Sokoto Caliphate
studentDocument.text: The Sokoto Caliphate established diplomatic embassies with neighboring Kanem-Borno and Tuareg sultanates to coordinate trans-Saharan caravan security and manage tribute collection along trading routes.
